options.label: Graphics backend
options.description: How the PS2 picture is drawn. Vulkan is usually fastest; Software is the most accurate but very slow.

options.label: Internal resolution
options.description: Draws games at a higher resolution for a sharper picture. Higher settings cost speed. Not used by the Software backend.

options.label: Aspect ratio
options.description: The shape of the picture. Game's own uses 4:3, or the game's widescreen mode when it has one.

options.label: Integer scaling
options.description: Scales the picture only by whole steps, so every pixel is the same size. Leaves black borders.

options.label: Screen filter
options.description: Sharp keeps hard pixel edges; Smooth blurs them slightly when the picture is scaled to the screen.

options.label: Widescreen hack
options.description: Applies a widescreen patch when one exists for the game, so it fills a wide screen. Can cause glitches.

options.label: VSync
options.description: Syncs frames to the screen to stop tearing. Can add a little input lag.

options.label: Show FPS
options.description: Shows the frame rate in a corner of the screen.

notes: Every key is read from ~/.config/ARMSX2/inis/PCSX2.ini (base layer); a game's own gamesettings/<SERIAL>_<CRC>.ini, when the player made one in ARMSX2, is a layer above it and wins for any [EmuCore/GS] key it holds (pcsx2/VMManager.cpp:1232-1250 UpdateGameSettingsLayer).
Booleans: SimpleIni writes and reads true/false (3rdparty/simpleini/include/SimpleIni.h:2372, pcsx2/INISettingsInterface.cpp:259); the seed and ARMSX2 write ' = '.

Renderer is an int enum: -1 Auto, 12 OpenGL, 13 Software, 14 Vulkan (pcsx2/Config.h:309-317; read as [EmuCore/GS] Renderer, pcsx2/Pcsx2Config.cpp:1125). USE_OPENGL and USE_VULKAN default ON on Linux (cmake/BuildParameters.cmake:42,44) and the Software renderer has an arm64 JIT (pcsx2/GS/Renderers/SW/GSDrawScanlineCodeGenerator.arm64.cpp).

Forcing Vulkan or OpenGL (anything but Auto or Software) shows 'Graphics API is not set to Automatic' once per run, unless [EmuCore] WarnAboutUnsafeSettings = false (pcsx2/VMManager.cpp:4185-4191, 4065). The seed leaves Renderer unset (Auto, which picks Vulkan on Turnip).
upscale_multiplier is a float written as '1', '2', '3', '4' (pcsx2/Pcsx2Config.cpp:1126; the UI's own values, pcsx2/ImGui/FullscreenUI_Settings.cpp:2847-2857). The Software renderer ignores it.
AspectRatio is a string enum: Stretch, Auto 4:3/3:2, 4:3, 16:9, ... (pcsx2/Pcsx2Config.cpp:659-669, read at :1014). 'Auto 4:3/3:2' is ARMSX2's default.
linear_present_mode: 0 Off (nearest), 1 Bilinear (Smooth), 2 Bilinear (Sharp) (pcsx2/Config.h:353-358, read at pcsx2/Pcsx2Config.cpp:1115).

EnableWideScreenPatches lives in [EmuCore] (pcsx2/Pcsx2Config.cpp:2195) and is deleted from per-game inis (:2378), so a game's ini cannot override it. It enables the 'Widescreen 16:9' patch from the bundled patches.zip (pcsx2/Patch.cpp:656; .github/workflows/linux_build_qt.yml:126-129) for games that have one.
